ValidationRule.description: Freight Implementation: To validate whether Accepted Quote is available while making an opportunity to Closed Accepted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
$RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight",
AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed - Accepted') ),
Freight_Quote_Count__c = 0
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer Quote must be accepted to mark this Opportunity as Closed-Accepted
